No. The pendulum strikes the cart, the cart knocks the weight off the track, and the weight lands on the seesaw. However, the cradle’s side walls hit the floor, stopping the seesaw near −16° instead of its −35° lower stop. The ball is thrown, but hits the cup’s outside far wall and comes to rest on the floor.

The correction explicitly positions both cradle side walls at the cradle’s along-coordinate; they were otherwise centred at the default along-position. This revision has not yet been simulated.
